UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile in the application.

id.description: The unique identifier for the user, matching the Firebase Auth UID.

customId.description: A custom, human-readable, and sequential ID for the user (e.g., KWUSR0001, KWENR0001).

state.description: The state where the user resides.

district.description: The district where the user resides.

depositBalance.description: The user's current wallet balance from deposits.

winningBalance.description: The user's current wallet balance from winnings.

commissionBalance.description: The enroller's current wallet balance from referral commissions.

totalDeposits.description: The cumulative sum of all completed deposits by the user.

totalWithdrawals.description: The cumulative sum of all completed withdrawals by the user.

status.description: The status of the user's account.

role.description: The role of the user in the application.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the user account was created.

createdBy.description: Indicates who created the user account.

enrollerId.description: If created by an enroller, this holds the enroller's UID.

commissionPaid.description: Indicates if the commission for this user's first qualifying deposit has been paid to the enroller.

paymentMethod.description: The user's preferred payment method for withdrawals.

bankName.description: The name of the user's bank.

accountHolderName.description: The name of the user as per bank records.

ifscCode.description: The IFSC code of the user's bank.

Market.title: Market
Market.description: Represents a game market with its timings and status.

name.description: The name of the market (e.g., Kalyan Day).

openResultTime.description: The result declaration time for the open panna.

closeResultTime.description: The result declaration time for the close panna.

status.description: The current status of the market.

BetType.title: Bet Type
BetType.description: Defines a type of bet that can be placed in a market.

name.description: The name of the bet type (e.g., Jodi, Single Panna).

description.description: A brief explanation of the bet type.

status.description: Whether this bet type is currently available for users.

GameRate.title: Game Rate
GameRate.description: Defines the payout rate for a specific game type.

name.description: The name of the game type (e.g., Single Digit).

betAmount.description: The standard amount for the bet (e.g., 10).

payoutAmount.description: The amount paid out for a winning bet of the standard amount (e.g., 950).

KalyanResult.title: Kalyan Result
KalyanResult.description: Represents a declared result for a specific market and date.

marketName.description: The name of the market the result is for (eg., Kalyan Day).

date.description: The date for which the result is declared.

closePanna.description: The 3-digit closing panna. Can be added later.

jodi.description: The 2-digit jodi, derived from the pannas. Calculated after closePanna is added.

PaymentSettings.title: Payment Settings
PaymentSettings.description: Stores the payment and other financial settings for the application.

upiId.description: The UPI ID for receiving payments.

bankAccountHolder.description: The name of the bank account holder.

bankIfscCode.description: The IFSC code of the bank.

bankAccountType.description: The type of the bank account.

referralBonusAmount.description: The commission amount to be paid to the enroller.

minDepositForBonus.description: The minimum deposit amount for the commission to be triggered.

minDeposit.description: The minimum amount a user can deposit in a single transaction.

minWithdrawal.description: The minimum amount a user can withdraw in a single transaction.

winningTaxPercentage.description: The percentage to be deducted as tax from winnings.

depositFeePercentage.description: The percentage to be deducted as a fee from deposits.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Represents a financial transaction in a user's wallet.

userId.description: The ID of the user who performed the transaction.

userName.description: The name of the user (for display purposes).

amount.description: The transaction amount. Positive for credits, negative for debits.

status.description: The current status of the transaction.

method.description: The method used for the transaction (e.g., UPI, Bank Transfer).

utr.description: The Unique Transaction Reference for deposits.

definition.description: Stores user profiles. Path-based ownership, where `userId` matches `request.auth.uid`.
Stores game market information. Publicly readable, but only writable by admins.
Stores the different types of bets available. Publicly readable, admin writable.
Stores declared game results. Publicly readable, admin writable.
Stores game payout rates. Publicly readable, admin writable.
Stores payment settings for the app. Only one document should exist with a fixed ID like 'main'. Publicly readable, admin writable.
Stores all financial transactions for all users. Readable by admins, writable by server actions.
